name: objective_aligned_h2_v1
hypothesis: The score-function gradient of the best reward among one detached greedy construction and three samples lowers development-set penalized returned-route duration relative to the saved H2 behavior-cloning checkpoints.
estimator_assumptions: R_best is the maximum normalized reward among the detached greedy decode and the three samples.
b is the detached greedy reward. The advantage is nonnegative and is zero when greedy wins.
The same advantage multiplies every sample log-probability. The winning sample is not the only term.
The greedy decode is under torch.no_grad. The estimator omits the greedy policy's dependence on the parameters.
The estimator is the score function for the sampling distribution with the greedy candidate held fixed.
decision_rule: Promising only if at least 4 of 5 seeds have a negative RL-minus-BC penalized anchored duration on dev_v2 and the paired Student-t 95% interval lies entirely below zero. confirm_v2 and the shift splits are not used to choose the checkpoint or the learning rate.
comparison_control: results/raw/bc_rl_final_v1 greedy-rollout runs use 4 samples plus 1 greedy decode per instance; this run uses 3 samples plus 1 greedy decode.
